notes.title: Dandy Ace Patch Notes v1.3.0.0.08
notes.notes:
The goal of this update was to improve the early game player experience. Dandy Ace has an extremely punishing first 40 minutes. This often causes players to give up on continuing to play before advancing.

The causes of this, which we were able to fix, were:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/5e8d78ff5ca02078da1bcf624cfacc16117ea546.png[/img]
Potion: Originally, the player only received the first potion after winning the 1st Area (Entrance Hall). However, this potion makes a big difference at the beginning of the game.

Change: The change we made is to give Dandy Ace a potion from the beginning of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/cc98f1e09eb464d6528caf14dac1cf10e1c008b0.jpg[/img]
Blueprints: One element that was always frustrating in Dandy Ace was losing Blueprints when dying in a run. This caused several problems, such as making it take much longer than necessary to unlock and find new cards.

Change: Now the player no longer loses Blueprints when losing a run.

Nnif-tar: Nnif-tar is a mechanic that allows the player to choose a card and increase its level. The idea is not to make the game so dependent on RNG. However, Nnif-tar originally took a long time to unlock.

Change: Nnif-tar starts unlocked from the beginning of the game.

More balancing changes (card damage and costs) will come in future updates

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Dandy Ace 1.2.0.0.24 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/65b6aeb27493b91b005ffe54ac5664592d3c6d4e.png[/img]
[u][h2][b]Mac Version[/b][/h2][/u]
The Mac version of Dandy Ace is now available (including the latest updates)!


[u][h2][b]Cards[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][b]Dash Update[/b][/h3]
To address a lot of feedback from players about getting stuck on corners and feeling helpless while using dashes instead of blinks, we made a big change to them. Now dashes can pass through gaps, obstacles, and corners!

Provided that the player has enough room for the dash and that the distance isn't too far as well, any level obstacle can be crossed while dashing, making Ace way more mobile when using a Dash Card.

[h3][b]Stun Update[/b][/h3]
Previously stuns would stop enemy actions for the duration of the stun, resuming them as soon as the CC effect was over. We felt like this created some weird moments for players that were expecting a different reaction (especially considering how the other CC in the game works). In this patch we changed how stuns work to make them more consistent with other CC types, now completely resetting all enemy actions when stunned.

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Enemy skills will still be out of their cooldowns, so they will still attack Ace as soon as they are not stunned anymore. The difference is that they will start attacking from the beginning of the action instead of resuming from the middle of it.

[h3][b]Card Simplification Update[/b][/h3]
We simplified the visuals on a lot of skills in the game improving their clarity so players don't get overwhelmed with too much information happening at the same time and skills as well as enemies don't blend together in a big mess.

Besides helping clarity, these changes also positively impact the performance of the game.

[u][b]The cards affected by these changes are:[/b][/u]

[b]Five of a Kind[/b] (Main and Upgrade)
[b]Bubble Trouble[/b] (Main and Upgrade)
[b]Titan Punch[/b]
[b]Shooting Stars[/b]
[b]Hack N Slash[/b]
[b]Poison Roses[/b]
[b]Trump Card[/b]
[b]Cosmic Vortex[/b] (Main and Upgrade)
[b]Escape Artist[/b] (Lele)

[h3][b]Performer's Refuge Drop Rate [/b][/h3]
From what we have heard from players that were finishing 100% of the game, in most cases the last card blueprint they needed in order to find all of the blueprints was the Performer's Refuge blueprint, which should not happen. Because of that we increased its drop rate, doubling the percentage of chance for it to be found by players.


[u][h2][b]General Updates[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][b]Optimization[/b][/h3]
We updated a lot of how the game works behind the scenes, improving greatly how the game runs in general. The main way players will feel these improvements is through the overall FPS of the game and the PC's memory usage while playing Dandy Ace.

[h3][b]Camera 60FPS Stutter[/b][/h3]
We have been receiving feedback since the game's launch from some players about the game feeling like it was stuttering while playing on 60 hz/FPS monitors. In this patch we managed to find what the issue was and fixed it, improving greatly how the game runs on these monitors.

[h3][b]Narration Frequency Update[/b][/h3]
We found that the way the narration frequency was being calculated on previous patches was not ideal, causing some players to feel like changing the frequency setting didn't change much during the actual gameplay. 

Trying to improve that, we changed how the cooldown between each Lele line was calculated, making it so the changes to frequency feel more impactful.

notes.title: Dandy Ace 1.1.0.0.8 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/0f6655ea015ea80d979b41a9421fd022a7ba40b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Cards[/b][/h2]
The focus on the Cards in this patch was mostly to make the melee cards stronger and better to use. As the gameplay was heavily dependent on the player's ability to kite the enemies, melee cards were not strong enough to compensate for not utilizing ranged cards.

[h3][b]Hack n' Slash[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Size increased:[/b] 15%
[*] [b]Base Damage increased:[/b]  34% (115 -> 155)
[*] [b]Casting Time decreased:[/b] 30% (0.1s -> 0.07s)
[*] [b]Recovery Time decreased:[/b] 30% (0.1s -> 0.07s)
[/list]
[h3][b]Titan Punch[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]First and Second Punch Casting Time decreased:[/b] 20% (0.1s -> 0.08s)
[*] [b]First and Second Punch Recovery Time decreased:[/b] 20% (0.1s -> 0.08s)
[*] [b]First and Second Punch dash force decreased:[/b] 30%
[*] [b]Third Punch Casting Time decreased: [/b]37.5% (0.2s -> 0.125s)
[*] [b]Third Punch dash force decreased: [/b]40%
[*] [b]All Punches Push strength decreased:[/b] 40%
[/list]
[h3][b]Spark Tornado[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Base Damage increased:[/b] 12.5% (200 -> 225)
[*] [b]Secondary Damage increased:[/b] 33% (37.5 -> 50)
[/list]
[h3][b]Five of a Kind[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Cooldown Decreased:[/b] 25% (0.8s -> 0.6s)
[*] [b]Collider Increased:[/b] 87.5%
[/list]
[h3][b]Flurry of Blows[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Base Damage increased: [/b]12.5% (400 -> 450)
[/list]
[h3][b]Starburst[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Base Damage increased:[/b] 28.5% (175 -> 225)
[/list]
[h3][b]Packet Trick[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Collider Increased:[/b] 50%
[*] [b]New Functionality:[/b] The explosive cards will also explode when the duration ends now. Before they only exploded if they made contact with an enemy.
[/list]

[h2][b]Dashes[/b][/h2]
Another big topic within the community was around our dash cards. We focused on improving the dashes usability and game feel, but we didn't add I-frames, as some players suggested (you can find a more detailed explanation on why we made this decision [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1037130/discussions/0/3082124889511586613/][b]here[/b][/url]).

The overall change was increasing how fast the dashes are, to make it more instantaneous, but also decreasing its distance. The distance is an important factor because the dashes were always covering a long distance, players would constantly take damage when dashing or they would have to pay more attention to farther parts of the map to dash safely.

The result of the change was a fast, almost instantaneous dash, with a more controlled distance. Allowing the players to be even more reactive without being too exposed during combat.
[list]
[*] [b]Increased Dash Speed:[/b] 60%
[*] [b]Decreased Dash Distance:[/b] 30%
[*] [b]Cooldown decreased:[/b] 15% (0.8s -> 0.7s)
[/list]
[h2][b]Starter Blue Card[/b][/h2]
Overall, new players gave us the feedback that they were finding blinks easier to use than dashes. Based on that, we decided to swap the starter blue card from a dash to a blink, with the objective to give a more friendlier experience to new players.
[list]
[*] [b]Starter Blue Card swap:[/b] Dashing Dash -> Time Warp
[/list]
[h2][b]Trinkets[/b][/h2]
In this patch we focused on strengthening some of the offensive trinkets. Players were not using these upgrades as much as we had hoped, since they didn’t feel quite as powerful as some of the other options.
[list]
[*] [b]Cloak of the Virtuoso damage increased: [/b]74%
[*] [b]Payback Knuckles damage decreased: [/b]20%
[*] [b]Pepperina Infuser damage increased:[/b] 90%
[/list]
[h2][b]Dandy Ace Movement[/b][/h2]
Another point of consistent feedback was that Dandy Ace's walk animation was a little bit "floaty" and that he was always moving too slowly. One of the biggest updates we made were to the walk animation, improving the gameplay feel. Now it feels like Dandy Ace is running in the palace and it feels much better!
[list]
[*] [b]Dandy Ace walk animation speed increased:[/b] 30%
[*] [b]Dandy Ace walk speed increased:[/b] 6%
[*] [b]Camera smoothness follow up decreased:[/b] 50%
[/list]
[h2][b]Shards and Grinding[/b][/h2]
One of the most frequent feedback was that to unlock Nnif's cards improvements were too expensive, forcing some players to grind it. For that, we decided to increase the bosses' shards reward. The idea is to allow the players to have access to more shards but only after defeating a boss.
[list]
[*] [b]Axolangelo and Scissorella shards drop increased:[/b] 50% (60 -> 90)
[*] [b]Severino shards drop increased:[/b] 50% (100 -> 150)
[*] [b]Lele shards drop increased:[/b] 50% (200 -> 300)
[/list]

[h2][b]Maps and Enemy Balancing[/b][/h2]
One of the biggest issues we saw within the early days of the game launch was that a lot of players were finding the Entrance Hall too difficult. Because of it, we decided to nerf some of the basic enemies, as well as targeting the Entrance Hall difficulty. The objective is to make the initial experience of the game more accessible and enjoyable.
[h3][b]Entrance Hall[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy Encounters:[/b] Overall, we decreased the amount of enemies the player will face in each combat encounter in this stage. Less enemies, more time for the player to learn the game. As for experienced players, playing through the Entrance Hall will be faster. It's a win-win change.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bunny Butler[/b][/h3]
As the Bunny Butler is the most basic enemy in the game, his attack was too strong. It was either too hard for the player to dodge or it was always putting the bunny in a position after the attack where new players weren't able to punish the enemy.
[list]
[*] [b]Charge Casting Time increased:[/b] 50% (0.4s -> 0.6s)
[*] [b]Charge distance decreased:[/b] 33%
[*] [b]Charge attack distance decreased:[/b] 20% (Now bunny butlers need to be 20% closer to the player to start the attack)
[*] [b]Walk speed increased:[/b] 15%
[/list]
[h3][b]Bunny Jester[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tumble Cooldown increased:[/b] 50%
[/list]
[h3][b]Other Enemies[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved several enemies' preview skills visibility
[*] Draculords now uses their attack, Blood Drinker, 40% closer to the player
[/list]
[h2][b]General Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Card Tier Assist[/b][/h3]
One of the most important concepts of our card system is the Card's tier. Basically, the higher the Card tier is, the more damage it deals. As a consequence of this, as the player progresses through the palace, the enemies are also higher tier. This means that if a player doesn't change their cards to higher tier cards or upgrade them with the Niftar unlock, the damage output will start to get too low, making it very difficult to beat the game.

However, one of the hardest part for new players is to understand the importance of the tiers amidst of all the cards, upgrades, and enemies. To aid the players, we added a visual cue system that will help players to understand the relative power of their cards compared to the map they are in.
[list]
[*][b] Green Number:[/b] card is very strong
[*] [b]White Number and Green Up-arrow:[/b] card is strong
[*] [b]White Number:[/b] card is average
[*] [b]White Number and Red Down-arrow:[/b] card is weak
[*] [b]Red Number:[/b] card is extremely weak
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/fb4141c4bdb0c629fe63eb8a0d9070ce2f8f0ba5.png[/img]
[h3][b]Entrance Hall First Gate[/b][/h3]
Now to be able to leave the first area of the Entrance Hall the player must collect the 3 initial starting cards.

[h2][b]Steam Trading Cards[/b][/h2]
Players will now be able to earn Dandy Ace Steam Trading Cards and craft game badges!

notes.title: Yellow Magic Cards - Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/6d519e09f3e00f01699962d7f4b28a03d5a04b22.png[/img]
Greetings Magicians,

This week we're going over the rest of the [b]Yellow Magic Cards[/b] available in Dandy Ace. These skills tend to be more utility focused providing Ace with personal shields, barriers, and a wide variety of crowd control options. Although damage isn’t a primary focus for these skills, they can still pack a punch! If you would like to read about the role Magic Cards play and the Yellow Magic Cards covered previously you can check out Part 1 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/3044967655736174481][b]HERE[/b][/url] as well as our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/2949254749587110922?snr=2_groupannouncements_detail_][b]Introduction to Magic Cards[/b][/url].

[h2][b]Decoy Ace[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/QQf8RDX/Decoy-Ace.png[/img]
       [/code]
Two Aces are better than one! [b]Decoy Ace[/b] is a tricky Yellow Magic Card that allows Ace to conjure a decoy that confuses enemies. Enemies will attack the decoy and once destroyed it will explode. All nearby enemies will take damage and gain the [b]Fear[/b] condition for a short period of time. Feared enemies will stop attacking and run away from Ace. Decoy Ace adds [b]Death Fear[/b] to any card it is used to upgrade. Death Fear applies on hit with the upgraded skill and will cause the enemy to spread [b]Fear[/b] to nearby enemies on death.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6H0sm07/Decoy-Ace-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Magician Overdrive[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/yFhZ3kZ/Magician-Overdrive.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Magician Overdrive[/b] is a powerful invulnerability based Yellow Magic Card. On activation Ace will come to a stop, releasing a burst of magic around him dealing a small amount of damage to enemies and making himself [b]Invulnerable[/b] for a short period of time. After the initial explosion Ace will gain the bonus of [b]Overdrive[/b] doubling Ace's damage while also causing him to take double damage for a brief period. Upgrading a card with Magician Overdrive will add [b]Overdrive [/b]to that card.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Swz22Gd/Magicians-Overdrive-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Scintillating Chains[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/CvbGYgp/Scintillating-Chains.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Scintillating Chains[/b] are a ranged Yellow Magic Card. Ace throws out mystical chains that will teleport Ace to the projectile's location on skill reactivation. Upon teleporting Ace will cause an explosion dealing damage and applying [b]Bind[/b] to all nearby enemies. Binded enemies are unable to move but can still attack. Upgrading a card with Scintillating Chains adds [b]Death Bind[/b]. Enemies affected by Death Bind will spread [b]Bind[/b] to all nearby enemies on death.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ncQwXjX/Scintillating-Chains-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Guardian Fairies[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/6nLG9gJ/Guardian-Fairies.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Guardian Fairies[/b] are a shield oriented Yellow Magic Card. When activated Ace will summon three fairies to protect him. The [b]Bullet Ward[/b] bonus makes the fairies destroy any enemy projectiles they come in contact with. Any enemies that collide with the fairies will take damage and also gain the [b]Weakness[/b] condition. Weakness makes enemies to deal 30% less damage to Ace for a short period of time. Upgrading a card with Guardian Fairies will cause its attacks to apply [b]Weakness[/b] to enemies on hit.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9ywzL81/Guardian-Fairies-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Event Horizon[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/Kj39xCG/Event-Horizon.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Event Horizon[/b] is a ranged AOE Yellow Magic Card. When activated Ace will fire a projectile that spawns a wormhole. Any enemies caught within it take damage and gain the [b]Slow[/b] condition for a short period of time. Slow causes enemy attack and movement speeds to be reduced by 50%.

Upgrading a card with Event Horizon adds [b]Death Slow[/b] to the card. The upgraded skill applies Death Slow on hit and will cause affected enemies to spread [b]Slow[/b] to nearby enemies on death.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Jk4dXZ9/Event-Horizon-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Cosmic Vortex[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/ZKVHc3j/Cosmic-Vortex.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Cosmic Vortex[/b] is an AOE based Yellow Magic Card. When used, Ace will conjure a big cosmic vortex around him. While it remains active Ace is unable to move. All enemies caught within the vortex will take damage for as long as they remain within it. Upgrading a card with Cosmic Vortex adds [b]Mini Vortex[/b] to the skill. On activation a smaller Cosmic Vortex will spawn around Ace but without restricting his movement.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/YdH45Md/Cosmic-Vortex-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Vanish[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/x1hyjs5/Vanish.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Vanish[/b] is a Yellow Magic Card that allows Ace to go invisible for a short period of time. When reactivated Ace will strike from the shadows dealing a significant amount of damage to the enemy he hits. Upgrading a card with Vanish will add [b]Invisibility[/b] to the skill. On skill activation, Ace will become invisible for a short period of time. Using any skill will cause Ace to come out of invisibility.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7MLs36/Vanish-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Ace Hook[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/whM6w8j/Ace-Hook.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Ace Hook[/b] is a ranged Yellow Magic Card. When used Ace will fire a hook projectile, if it collides with an enemy it will [b]Stun[/b] and [b]Pull[/b] them towards Ace. When used to upgrade any other card, Ace Hook adds [b]Death Stun[/b] to the upgraded skill. When an enemy affected by Death Stun dies, all nearby enemies are stunned briefly.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/LpjPcCg/Ace-Hook-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Consume Power[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/bzyVTwX/Consume-Power.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Consume Power[/b] is an AOE based Yellow Magic Card. When activated, Ace will release a powerful burst around him dealing damage to nearby enemies. The skill also has an added bonus called [b]Consume Power[/b]. This makes the skill deal extra damage for every buff Ace has and removes from himself.

Upgrading a card with Consume Power adds [b]Power from Within[/b]. When Ace has any buff active, the upgraded skill will deal more damage.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZJPYJbn/Consume-Power-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Binding Chains[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/94DTGXS/Binding-Chains.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Binding Chains[/b] is a ranged Yellow Magic Card. Ace will send out magical chains that will [b]Bind[/b] and damage any enemies hit. Bind stops enemies from moving for a short period of time. The upgrade effect will vary depending on the color of the card it is combined with. Combining Binding Chains with a Yellow or Blue Magic Card adds [b]Bind[/b] to the skill. Pink Magic Cards gain [b]Delusional Freedom[/b] which causes Binded enemies to take more damage from the upgraded skill.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/GvVr0fK/Binding-Chains-Gif.gif[/img]

Check out the free Dandy Ace demo and try many of these cards out yourself available on the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037130/Dandy_Ace/]Steam Page[/url][/b] prior to Dandy Ace’s Steam Launch on March 25th! notes.title: Yellow Magic Cards - Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/91f14f7fac08a1e1ee92149a56bc0c79b510d318.png[/img]
Greetings Magicians,

Today we’ll be starting to cover the final Magic Card type you’ll encounter in Dandy Ace, [b]Yellow Magic Cards[/b]. You can read more about how Magic Cards are utilized as skills in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/2949254749587110922?snr=2_groupannouncements_detail_]Introduction to Magic Cards[/url]. Unlike the mobility focused Blue Magic Cards and the damage oriented Pink Magic Cards, [b]Yellow Magic Cards[/b] offer up more utility based skill options to Ace. Yellow Magic Cards have the widest variety of mechanics associated with them and can range from giant barriers & personal shields to slow fields and stuns.

[b][h2]Dazzling Display[/h2][/b]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/YdVbv7d/Dazzling-Display.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Dazzling Display[/b] is a short to mid-ranged Yellow Magic Card. When activated Ace will cast a bright cone of dazzling light in the direction he is facing. Any enemies caught within the light will be stunned for a short period of time.

The upgrade effect for Dazzling Display varies depending on the color of the card it upgrades. For Yellow and Blue Magic Cards, Dazzling Display adds [b]Stun[/b] when damaging an enemy to the upgraded skill. When upgrading a Pink Magic Card, it will add [b]Prey Seeker[/b] instead. Prey Seeker causes stunned enemies to take more damage from the affected skill.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/dk2bGRg/Dazzling-Display-Gif.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Magical Barrier[/h2][/b]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/RDgKnGL/Magical-Barrier.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Magical Barrier[/b] is a shield based Yellow Magic Card. Ace creates a big moving barrier that destroys enemy projectiles on contact thanks to the [b]Bullet Ward[/b] effect. Enemies in its path will be pushed back and also have the [b]Weakness[/b] condition applied. Weakness causes enemies to deal 30% less damage to Ace for a short period of time. 

The upgrade effect for Magical Barrier is [b]Death Weakness[/b]. The upgraded skill applies Death Weakness to enemies on hit. Affected enemies will spread Weakness to other nearby enemies on death.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/s1bbrq6/Magical-Barrier-Gif.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Time Dissonance[/h2][/b]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/C1mn9PG/Time-Dissonance.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Time Dissonance[/b] is an AOE based Yellow Magic Card. On activation Ace will create a magical [b]Slow Field[/b] that damages and slows enemies in it. The Slow Field also has the added benefit of slowing enemy projectiles that pass through it. Upgrading a card with Time Dissonance will add [b]Slow[/b] to Yellow and Blue Magic Cards while Pink cards get [b]Relentless Pursuit[/b]. Any enemies hit by the upgraded Pink Magic Card will take additional damage if they are affected by Slow thanks to Relentless Pursuit.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/BgQyYPX/Time-Dissonance-Gif.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Aegis Cloak[/h2][/b]
[code]                     [img]https://i.ibb.co/p4c5CYH/Aegis-Cloak.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Aegis Cloak[/b] is a very powerful shield based Yellow Card. On activation Ace creates a shield around himself and the next hit that would damage Ace will be absorbed. The shield explodes when destroyed, dealing damage to nearby enemies. As an upgrade, Aegis Cloak adds [b]Invulnerability[/b] making Ace immune to all damage for a short period of time when the upgraded skill is activated. This effect has an internal cooldown.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/k4GmS6G/Aegis-Cloak-Gif.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Packet Trick[/h2][/b]
[code]                     [img]https://i.ibb.co/FJspgG2/Packet-Trick.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Packet Trick[/b] is a ranged AOE Yellow Magic Card that is often used as a trap. Ace drops a group of explosive cards on the ground. The cards explode and deal damage to enemies on contact. This skill combos well when combined with crowd control based cards such as those that add Stun or the Charm condition. The upgrade effect of Packet Trick is [b]Death Bomb[/b]. Enemies damaged by the upgraded skill will explode and deal damage to all nearby enemies.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/mzQ9MMY/Packet-Trick-Gif.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Passion Comet[/h2][/b]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/2S2Rq0d/Passion-Comet.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Passion Comet[/b] is a ranged Yellow Magic Card. On activation Ace shoots a comet that explodes once it reaches its max range or collides with an enemy. Any enemies caught in the blast will take damage and also gain the [b]Charm[/b] condition. While affected by Charm, enemies will slowly move towards Ace and can't attack for a short period of time. Upgrading any card with Passion Comet adds [b]Death Charm[/b]. Any enemies hit by the upgraded skill will spread Charm to nearby enemies on death.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y0S9NLn/Passion-Comet-Gif.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Starburst[/h2][/b]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/y6TKX87/Starburst.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Starburst[/b] is an AOE based Yellow Magic Card. On activation, Ace will release a burst of magic and push back all enemies around him while also dealing damage to any enemies hit. The upgrade effect of Starburst adds [b]Push[/b]. The upgraded skill will push enemies back enemies on successful hit.


You can experiment with some of these and other Magic Cards in our free demo available on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037130/Dandy_Ace/]Store Page[/url] prior to Dandy Ace Steam Launch on March 25th! We’ll be covering the rest of the Yellow Magic Cards in one of our next blog posts so be sure to add Dandy Ace to your Wishlist and follow us on all of our social media to stay up to date on all announcements and news.

notes.title: Welcome to the Guest Lounge: Bunny Bomber, Lady Hook, & the Torch Maids
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/cbdab3fafd124cd010e09a5e058fe0388bc3fc40.png[/img]

Just beyond Axolangelo’s Atelier lies Lele’s exclusive Guest Lounge where Ace will encounter [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/3042713319722426221]Candlestick Bombardiers[/url][/b] along with [b]Bunny Bombers[/b], [b]Lady Hook[/b], and the [b]Torch Maids[/b]. You’ll get your first chance to enter the Guest Lounge after successfully reaching and defeating Dandy Ace’s first boss, Axolangelo. This decorated lounge for all of Lele’s Palace Guests features beautiful vases, potted plants, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/2924486854021519364]Homing Turrets[/url][/b], and a [b]Goo Bomb[/b] that can really slow things down.

[h2][b]Goo Bomb[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/3f502a9abd761ca34cdc33fa45a08d744b7295ba.png[/img]

The [b]Goo Bomb[/b] will cause problems for Ace if he isn’t quick on his feet but can also serve as another tool in his bag of tricks if utilized correctly. Upon walking over the Goo Bomb it will activate and explode after a short delay. If Ace or any enemies are caught within the radius they will take damage and have the [b]Slow[/b] condition applied reducing the affected target’s movement speed for a short period of time.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Js8RQG1/Goo-Trap-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Bunny Bomber[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/e30974de63f59ca7018bb692ff3f1a2cbe2eb66d.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Bunny Bomber[/b] does not take kindly to uninvited guests and carries around a large bomb to chase down any intruders. Once spotted, the Bunny Bomber will begin a [b]Slow Chase[/b] towards Ace heading directly at him. After a few seconds or once within range this will turn into a [b]Fast Chase[/b] allowing the Bunny Bomber to get close to Ace and activate [b]Stolen Bomb-Head[/b]. The large bomb is immediately dropped causing it to explode and deal damage to Ace. This chaotic bunny will have to retreat to safety and find another bomb before returning to attack again.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/znt0kNd/Bunny-Bomber-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Lady Hook[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/e1cfc6d9e08802abe487cd0ebc658f81f89ce24e.gif[/img]
          [/code]
Lele’s guests may have dressed up but they aren’t afraid to get in a fight. [b]Lady Hook[/b] and her trusty [b]Golden Hook[/b] will put an end to Ace’s shenanigans if he gets too close. This melee attack deals a lot of damage directly in front of Lady Hook. Hiding behind the potted plants and decor won’t save you for long. If Ace remains at range for an extended period of time Lady Hook will need to utilize her [b]hook pull[/b] to damage and bring Ace in closer.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xzSJ6ry/Lady-Hook-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Torch Maid[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/63620b6b377e5668bfd182819622703b4c142318.gif[/img]
          [/code]
[b]Torch Maids[/b] do a great job of keeping the Guest Lounge clean and tidy. This upgraded version of the Broom Maid utilizes a spear and poses a much bigger threat to Ace. [b]Blink n’ Spear[/b] allows the Torch Maid to surprise Ace by blinking behind him and following up with a single spear attack. If within melee range the Torch Maid will perform a 3-part [b]Mega Combo[/b] thrusting the spear in Ace’s direction twice before surrounding herself with blue flames and damaging anything within its radius.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ryzh8mg/Torch-Maid-Gif.gif[/img]

Fight your way through the Guest Lounge when Dandy Ace launches on Steam on [b]March 25th[/b]. Players can also try out the free demo available on our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037130/Dandy_Ace/]Steam Store Page[/url][/b] until then if they’d like to try their hand at reaching Axolangelo’s Atelier. If you haven’t already, please consider adding Dandy Ace to your wishlist and follow our social media channels below as we’ll have plenty of exciting events and news to share with you all over the next couple of weeks leading up to launch!

notes.title: Pink Magic Cards: Damage - Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/3d62205c4ba52310f5a3c252ef0aefd879049d56.png[/img]

Greetings Magicians,

Today we’ll be going over the rest of the Pink Magic Cards available to players in Dandy Ace! Pink Magic Cards are more damage oriented and are split into two primary categories of Melee & Ranged skills. You can read up on all of the pink cards previously covered in last week’s blog post [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/3043839853303949171]HERE[/url][/b]. To those new to Dandy Ace, Magic Cards act as the skills players collect and use as they take on the different enemies and bosses encountered within the Cursed Mirror. Players are able to create countless combinations of skills and play styles by combining the different cards they come across on each run. You can read more about the role the cards play in our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/2949254749587110922?snr=2_groupannouncements_detail_]Introduction to Magic Cards[/url][/b].

[b][h2]Sugar Dandy[/h2][/b]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/e014d2753e2487f5df580c312ae248e118ae102b.png[/img]
       [/code]

[b]Sugar Dandy[/b] is a long ranged Pink Magic Card. On use Ace will shoot a powerful arrow that gets stronger the longer Ace holds it down prior to firing. The arrow travels in a straight line, dealing damage to and piercing enemies until it reaches its max range. Any enemies hit will also gain the [b]Charm[/b] condition. Charm causes enemies to walk slowly towards Ace for a short period of time while also being locked out of attacking.

The upgrade effect of Sugar Dandy varies depending on the type of card it is combined with. When used to upgrade Yellow and Blue Magic Cards, the skills will apply Charm to enemies on hit. If used to upgrade a Pink Magic Card, the card gains [b]Broken Hearts[/b]. Any enemies affected by Charm will take increased damage from the skill.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KhVWtPf/Sugar-Dandy-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Dio, The Bat[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]https://i.ibb.co/qLHhbPF/Dio-The-Bat.webp[/img]
       [/code]

[b]Dio, The Bat[/b] is an infamous vampire bat. This Pink Magic Card is a ranged skill allowing Ace to send Dio, The Bat out at enemies and apply a [b]Bleed[/b] condition on hit. Dio, The Bat will travel in a straight line very quickly and return right back to Ace on skill reactivation. Enemies can be hit both ways and the Bleed condition will also apply on each hit. Bleed will cause enemies to take damage over a short period of time.

As an upgrade Dio, The Bat continues to bleed enemy health down. Upgrading a card with Dio, The Bat will add [b]Death Bleed[/b] to the skill on hit. When an affected enemy dies, they will spread Bleed to all nearby enemies causing them to take damage over a short period of time.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/D7p57Hh/Dio-The-Bat-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Toxic Spray[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]https://i.ibb.co/w4CLtQb/Toxic-Spray.webp[/img]
       [/code]

[b]Toxic Spray[/b] is a mid-ranged Pink Magic Card capable of hitting multiple enemies. On activation Ace creates a poisonous cloud dealing damage to enemies within it and also applying a [b]Poison [/b]condition to them. Poison causes enemies to take damage over a short period of time and stacks with other similar conditions. The upgrade effect adds Poison on enemy hit to whichever card Toxic Spray is combined with.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WWTJRT9/Toxic-Spray-GIf.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Blossom Blast[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/ctd0rdJ/Blossom-Blast.webp[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Blossom Blast[/b] is a powerful AOE based Pink Magic Card that can be cast at range. Ace casts the skill on an area, exploding after a brief delay. Any enemies caught within the radius will take significant damage. Blossom Blast will add [b]Blooming Burst[/b] to a skill if used as an upgrade. Blooming Burst deals additional explosive burst damage after a short delay after hitting an enemy.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/d44hwPw/Blossom-Blast-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Crushing Hand[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/wMc7LLX/Crushing-Hand.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Crushing Hand[/b] is a melee Pink Magic Card with a powerful upgrade effect. On activation Ace will drop a giant fist down directly in front of him, crushing and damaging anything beneath it. Crushing Hand also benefits from an added bonus called [b]Calculated Risks[/b]. While Ace is under 50% HP, Calculated Risks will cause Crushing Hand to deal more damage.

Upgrading a card with Crushing Hand adds[b] Life Siphon[/b]. When damaging an enemy with the upgraded skill Ace will receive some health back. This effect does have an internal cooldown so Ace won't be able to constantly heal but can come in handy when you find yourself out of tea and cupcakes!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RYgPyN0/Crushing-Hand-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Trump Card[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/PW9f8fN/Trump-Card.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Trump Card[/b] is a ranged explosive Pink Magic Card. On use Ace will throw a magical card that travels in a straight line. When the skill is activated again the card will explode dealing damage to all enemies near it. When used as an upgrade Trump Card adds [b]Illusion of Life[/b] to the upgraded skill. Illusion of Life causes enemies with more than 50% remaining HP to take additional damage from the skill.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/K9PvBDZ/Trump-Card-Gif.gif[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Poison Roses[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/T8hJWsn/Poison-Roses.webp[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Poison Roses[/b] is a ranged Pink Magic Card. On use Ace will throw out 3 poisonous roses at once. Each rose can deal damage and apply the [b]Poison[/b] condition to enemies on hit. If played at the appropriate range, the roses can intersect and deal the full damage of all 3. This skill is charge based so Ace will be able to use the skill multiple times before having to wait for each charge to individually come back off cooldown.

Poison Roses adds [b]Death Poison[/b] to any card it upgrades. When an enemy affected by Death Poison is killed, they will spread Poison to all nearby enemies. Poison causes enemies to take damage over a short period of time.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/jkHGs4r/Poison-Rose-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Flurry of Blows[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/y66h9TK/Flurry-of-Blows.webp[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Flurry of Blows[/b] is a melee based Pink Magic Card. When used Ace will strike in front of him with a flurry of blows. Ace is unable to move for a short period while the skill is active. All enemies caught within the attack will take damage. Flurry of Blows adds [b]Accumulated Pain[/b] to any card it upgrades. With Accumulated Pain the upgraded skill will deal additional damage to any enemies affected by Bleeding, Burning, or Poison conditions.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fNHDmWt/Flurry-Of-Blows-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Spark Tornado[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/HNFR6Tq/Spark-Tornado.webp[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Spark Tornado[/b] is a close ranged AOE Pink Magic Card. On activation Ace conjures a tornado around him. For each enemy hit by the tornado, Spark Tornado will deal additional damage thanks to its added bonus [b]Rampage Surge[/b]. When upgrading a card with Spark Tornado, the skill will earn[b] Fast Cast[/b]. Fast Cast allows the upgraded skill to be cast faster than normal.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/s9zLjL0/Spark-Tornado-Gif.gif[/img]

[code]                      [img]https://i.ibb.co/VNckXdD/Hack-N-Slash.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Hack N' Slash[/b] is a melee based Pink Magic Card. On activation Ace will quickly strike in front of him dealing damage to all enemies caught in the slash. This skill has a short range but a very short cooldown of .1 seconds allowing it to be used over and over. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/NYW98Gk/Hack-NSlash.gif[/img]

Hack N’ Slash works very well when upgraded with cards that can utilize its fast attacks or increase its potential range, such as with the size increase provided by [b]Hungry Chomper[/b].
As an upgrade, Hack N' Slash adds [b]Perfect Execution[/b] to a card. Perfect Execution causes enemies below 50% HP to take extra damage from that skill.

notes.title: Pink Magic Cards: Damage - Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/79ed9ba0ba1d049a01b8b45cb141331ec5dc730f.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone that played Dandy Ace during the Creators’ Preview Event! We really enjoyed watching streamers and their communities experiment with Twitch Mode. The team appreciates all of the positive comments and feedback we’ve received as well. We will have more news on our upcoming launch soon so make sure to add Dandy Ace to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037130/Dandy_Ace/][b]Steam Wishlist[/b][/url] if you haven’t already, it helps us out a lot!

This week we’re diving into the next kind of Magic Card you’ll have at your disposal as you make your way through Lele’s Palace, [b]Pink Magic Cards[/b]. As mentioned in our Introduction to Magic Cards, Dandy Ace’s core mechanic revolves around the Magical Cards which act as skills in the game. Players are able to create countless combinations of skills, upgrades, and play styles by combining the different cards they come across on each run. [b]Pink Magic Cards[/b] are more damage oriented and are split into Melee and Ranged skills.

[h2][b]Five of a Kind[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/a415a8f45e3225abc9aa17e8e2440be65d0a7135.png[/img]
       [/code]

[b]Five of a Kind[/b] is a ranged Pink Magic Card and is the first card Ace will come across. On activation, Ace throws five magical cards in a cone in front of him. Each individual card will deal damage if it collides with an enemy. This skill is charge based which allows Ace to be able to use this skill multiple times in a row. Five of a Kind recharges one charge at a time so Ace may want to think about utilizing some of his other skills while waiting for more charges to maximize burst potential. 

When utilized as an upgrade, Five of a Kind adds [b]Wild Cards[/b]. After successfully hitting an enemy with the upgraded skill, 5 cards will spawn and damage other nearby enemies. There is no cooldown on this upgrade effect.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/c1MkZnn/Five-Of-AKind-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Bubble Trouble[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/2bd3b141e30c7e335c39b0a748f7bcf766be99b3.png[/img]
       [/code]
A ranged Pink Magic Card, [b]Bubble Trouble[/b] provides Ace with great damage and explosive potential. On activation Ace will shoot a big bubble out that will travel in a straight line until its max range or it collides with an enemy. Upon collision the bubble will burst dealing damage and spawning [b]Bubble Cluster[/b]. After a short delay, Bubble Cluster will deal additional AOE damage at the collision location. This skill can be held longer to increase the bubble's travel speed.

Upgrading a card with Bubble Trouble will give it [b]Bubble Cluster[/b]. On enemy hit, Bubble Cluster spawns dealing AOE damage to any enemies within it.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/cYgQFJB/Bubble-Trouble-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Titan Punch[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/64c2c782e88cfa39e4f56f300da87bbcf8ba4a2f.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Titan Punch[/b] is a melee based Pink Magic Card that rewards utilizing it multiple times in a combo. On activation Ace will deal damage directly in front of him with a giant fist. The second punch will stun enemies for a short period of time. The third punch in the combo will also briefly stun while dealing additional damage. Hitting an enemy with Titan Punch will give them the [b]Vulnerability[/b] condition.

Utilizing Titan Punch as an upgrade to another card will add [b]Vulnerability[/b] to that skill on enemy hit. Vulnerability causes affected enemies to take additional damage from all sources for a short period of time.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RBV1Mqk/Titan-Punch-Gif.gif[/img]


[h2][b]Call Lightning[/b][/h2]
[code]                     [img]https://i.ibb.co/wWjMm4X/Call-Lightning.webp[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Call Lightning[/b] is a ranged AOE Pink Magic Card. When used Ace will cast two lightning bolts that strike an area one right after another in a large radius. All enemies caught within the area will take damage with each hit. Holding the skill longer will increase the size of the radius.

Call Lightning's upgrade effect is [b]Minor Lightning[/b]. On successful enemy hit, Minor Lightning will cause lightning to strike the enemy for additional damage after a short delay.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/VwnSQWv/Call-Lightning-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Crescendo Fireworks[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/cf6f059789a23d1e02d69af54957bbaddf538567.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Crescendo Fireworks[/b] is a ranged Pink Magic Card utilizing both hold and damage over time. The longer Ace holds down Crescendo Fireworks prior to firing, the larger the explosion gets. On release, Ace shoots out a firework that explodes on contact or once it reaches its max range. The explosion deals damage and applies the [b]Burn[/b] condition to enemies hit. Any enemy with Burn will take damage over a short period of time.

Upgrading a card with Crescendo Fireworks adds [b]Burn[/b] to the card. On hit, enemies will take burn damage over time.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/thxYVZG/Crescendo-Fireworks-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Twin Daggers[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/883fa2cc812c00e53befab9d6f0830bae85620ca.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Twin Daggers[/b] are a range based Pink Magic Card. When activated Ace sends out two giant daggers that travel side by side in a straight line dealing damage and applying a [b]Bleed[/b] condition to all enemies in its path. One of the greatest strengths of this card is its ability to pierce through multiple enemies. Enemies hit will take an initial burst of damage followed by additional damage over a short period of time from the Bleed.

Upgrading a card with Twin Daggers adds the[b]Bleed[/b] condition to it. On hit, enemies will begin to take Bleed damage over a short period of time.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/djXNRjW/Twin-Daggers-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Dancing Wand[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/d0b7aa9c3483f07518e887802e0e5aafe800c953.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Dancing Wand[/b] is a very powerful Pink Magic Card that is great with dealing with large groups of enemies. On activation, Ace throws out a magical wand that bounces between enemies dealing damage on each bounce. This skill has a short cooldown and can be thrown quickly.

When Dancing Wand is used as an upgrade it adds [b]Chain Damage[/b] to the card. Chain Damage causes the skill to deal additional damage to nearby enemies on hit.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/cXSGrN7/Dancing-Wand-Gif.gif[/img]


[h2][b]Shooting Stars[/b][/h2]
[code]                      [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/6c3b0f4e7d767a56639f6b9f807f9e2add6a72a7.png[/img]
       [/code]

[b]Shooting Stars[/b] is a ranged Pink Magic Card. Shooting Stars allows Ace to fire off several stars quickly one right after the other, traveling in a straight line until it collides with an enemy or reaches its max range. Every third shooting star Ace fires will explode on contact or at its max range dealing damage to all enemies nearby.

Shooting Stars has an upgrade effect that is used to increase the potential burst damage of another spell. Any card upgraded with Shooting Stars gains [b]Empower Magic[/b] which increases the overall damage of the skill on hit. This upgrade effect has a cooldown so the increased damage will only apply when after the internal cooldown.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/p1KZ52L/Shooting-Stars-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Sim Sala Beam[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/054a3811969d683e7a0141a98580d44178471e26.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Sim Sala Beam[/b] is a ranged Pink Magic Card. On activation, Ace will channel his magic into a powerful beam. The longer you hold the skill down prior to releasing the larger the beam gets. Any enemies caught in the beam take a significant amount of damage and also have a [b]Burn[/b] condition applied to them. Burn causes enemies to take additional damage over a short period of time.

The upgrade effect for Sim Sala Beam is [b]Death Burn[/b]. Any skill upgraded with Sim Sala Beam will add the Death Burn condition to enemies on hit which will spread Burn to other nearby enemies when they are defeated.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/HdDbwDZ/Sim-Sala-Beam-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Hungry Chomper[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/2002dd77a37599ae575d158297fc3518b83410fe.png[/img]
       [/code]
The final Pink Magic Card we’ll be going over this week is [b]Hungry Chomper[/b]. This is a ranged Pink Magic Card. On use Ace sends out a Chomper that will travel in a straight line dealing damage to any enemies in its path. This skill pierces through enemies and for each enemy it pierces it grows in size and damage.

Upgrading a card with Hungry Chomper adds [b]Size Increase[/b]. This increases the size of the upgraded skill.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/12b9hFj/Hungry-Chomper-Gif.gif[/img]

We’ll cover the rest of the Pink Magic Cards in Part 2 later this month. In the meantime be sure to add Dandy Ace to your Wishlist and follow all of our social media channels. notes.title: Welcome to the Central Hall: Royal Rabbit, Broom Maid, & More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/23a02201fd3bd65d74749a17387df708c8e0b65e.png[/img]
[h3][b]CENTRAL HALL[/b][/h3]

The [b]Central Hall[/b] is the next map in our map and enemy spotlight series. As the name might suggest, the Central Hall is located at the center of Lele’s Palace and can be entered through the Banquet Hall or Courtyard if you have the necessary gate keys to unlock the paths. This map is home to a variety of new challenging enemies for Ace to take on including the [b]Broom Maid[/b], [b]Candlestick Bombardier[/b], [b]Royal Rabbit[/b], [b]Twilight Phantom[/b], and [b]Multi-Shot Turret[/b]. Ace will also need to be careful navigating the Central Hall as it features Protective Totems and a different kind of environmental hazard, the [b]Furnace[/b]. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zVW8LhF/Central-Hall-Gif.gif[/img]

While making your way through the Central Hall you’ll be able to find two possible exits, one to [b]Axolangelo’s Atelier[/b] and the other to [b]Scissorella’s Garden[/b]. This allows you to decide which boss you want to face depending on the cards you have, better adapting your decision to each of their playstyles.

[h3]FURNACE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/8cc8a58898555e9d548fec5f3f11015a10273f2d.png[/img]

The Central Hall’s environmental hazard will surely heat things up in the midst of combat. The [b]Furnace[/b] requires Ace to step on the pressure plates found on the ground in the Central Hall to activate them. These plates can’t be activated by enemies. After a short delay, flames will erupt out of every vent in the hall damaging anything standing on top of them. The pressure plates will reset after a short period and can be activated by Ace again.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QfFpXYG/Furnace-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]CANDLESTICK BOMBARDIER[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/648e00fccc5a3e3bcf9c12c9347a1a774a514ed8.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Candlestick Bombardier[/b] is an upgraded version of the Candlestick Bomber found in earlier maps. Similar to the Bomber’s [b]Blast[/b] offensive skill, the Candlestick Bombardier can cast [b]Cluster Blast[/b] underneath Ace’s location from range. After a short delay the area will explode dealing damage to Ace if he remains within it. Following the initial explosion, 4 smaller [b]Blasts[/b] will occur surrounding it in a cluster. Attempting to get close to the Candlestick Bombardier will cause it to [b]Teleport[/b] a good distance away from Ace before resuming its attacks. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6rySp5t/Bombardier-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]ROYAL RABBIT[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/7666bad6db16e645c159be168175b4a4fc1298c3.gif[/img]
          [/code]
An upgraded version of the Bunny Butler, the [b]Royal Rabbit[/b] relies on a lance as its weapon of choice instead of a giant fork. This enemy is much tougher than the Bunny Butler that Ace encounters in the Entrance Hall so don’t underestimate it! If Ace remains at range the Royal Rabbit will attempt to get in close enough to [b]Charge[/b] in Ace’s direction, damaging him on collision. The Royal Rabbit also has a melee attack at its disposal with [b]Thrust[/b] should Ace get too close.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/NSj6SC3/Royal-Rabbit-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]BROOM MAID[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/34f1ec2302510b5fd22f335068f880f414a3075a.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Broom Maid[/b] works hard to keep the Central Hall clean and doesn’t take kindly to guests making a mess. [b]Flame Sweep[/b] is a mid-ranged two part attack that activates once the Broom Maid is within range of Ace. The Broom Maid will swing her broom in the direction of Ace leaving a trail of flames. This attack is performed twice in a row. The flames will disappear after a few seconds.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vqRTqQX/Broom-Maid-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]TWILIGHT PHANTOM[/h3]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/18e3a8b0f71ca8fab7663a77ed1bdfa597af20d8.gif[/img]
          [/code]
The [b]Twilight Phantom[/b] is the upgraded version of the Midnight Phantom. Armed with both a ranged and melee offensive skill, the Twilight Phantom will always be a threat. [b]Boomerang[/b] fires a projectile ring that returns to the Twilight Phantom once reaching its max range. Any enemies that it collides with will take damage. Getting too close will cause the Twilight Phantom to activate [b]Combo Slash[/b], swinging at Ace 3 times and moving in his direction quickly.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/FztPjr9/Twilight-Phantom-Gif.gif[/img]

[h3]Multi-Shot Turret[/h3]

The Central Hall has a different type of turret than those found in previous maps. The 
[b]Multi-Shot Turret[/b] has 3 projectiles floating above it. Acting as the shotgun of turrets, the Multi-Shot Turret fires [b]Spread Shot[/b] towards Ace when within range. Spread Shot sends out 3 projectiles in a cone simultaneously, each dealing its own damage on successful hit. Ace will need to quickly maneuver between the multiple projectiles while fighting off enemies.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hBpXM8R/Multi-Turret-Gif.gif[/img]


The Central Hall is currently available in the free demo during our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/3047216285005208414][b]Creators’ Preview Event[/b][/url] until February 1st. notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/aa65a47e8654d8f389f617759a2af5725c9784e5.png[/img]
Hey Magicians!

The Creators’ Preview Event has been a blast so far and we appreciate everyone that has played and wishlisted Dandy Ace. We’ve received a lot of feedback from players and streamers, especially for Twitch Mode, and have started making changes to improve the overall experience. The Patch Notes for our latest Twitch Mode update that went live earlier today can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/3047216284991637519][b]HERE[/b][/url].

This week we’ll be covering the rest of the mobility based Blue Magic Cards found within Dandy Ace. If you'd like to check out Part 1 of the Blue Magic Cards you can find it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/2941374718649044426][b]HERE[/b][/url]. As mentioned previously in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1037130/view/2949254749587110922]Introduction to Magic Cards[/url], Dandy Ace’s core mechanic revolves around the Magical Cards which act as skills in the game. Players are able to create countless combinations of skills, upgrades, and play styles by combining the different cards they come across on each run. Blue Magic Cards fall into two categories: [b]Blinks[/b] & [b]Dashes[/b]. Dashes allow Ace to travel forward and pass through enemies but do not offer any invulnerability frames during the dash. Blinks on the other hand allow Ace to teleport forward a short distance, avoiding any enemy attacks that may be between the start and end points.

[h2][b]Time Warp[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/fd9df8d5138e3e17b3edc818d91aa4263480399d.png[/img] 
       [/code]
[b]Time Warp[/b] is one of Ace's most basic blink cards. Time Warp allows Ace to quickly blink forward and cause an AOE explosion. Ace deals damage to any enemies around him at his blink end-location.

Upgrading a card with Time Warp adds [b]Dimensional Burst[/b] to the card which will cause Ace to deal damage to all enemies in a short range AOE around him when the upgraded skill is activated.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/93LHr23/Time-Warp-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Toxic Retreat[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/2821124ea668fff24c0358c1cbb9e2265ed5ef10.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Toxic Retreat[/b] is a blink based Blue Card. On activation Ace will blink forward and simultaneously apply a [b]Toxic debuff[/b] to any enemies near him at his initial location. [b]Toxic[/b] causes the affected enemy to form a toxic field around them that deals damage to the enemy over a short period of time as well as others around them. As the card's name suggests, this skill is best utilized when blinking out of groups of enemies or to retreat as you have to be near the enemies to apply the Toxic debuff. If utilized as an upgrade, Toxic Retreat will add the Toxic debuff to any card, applying to enemies on hit.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4RvbrNB/Toxic-Retreat-Gif.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Escape Artist[/b][/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/b55e35ddf6f98f1c43c9804b37708d436f559402.png[/img]
       [/code]
[b]Escape Artist[/b] is a blink based Blue Magic Card. On use, Ace blinks forward leaving behind a [b]Noxious Cloud[/b]. Any enemies affected by or entering the cloud will take damage for as long as they remain within it. Upgrading a card with Escape Artist adds [b]Noxious Cloud[/b] to that card, creating a cloud when the upgraded card is used.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Pr210Nc/Escape-Artist-Gif.gif[/img]

After a short period the phantom returns to him, creating a big explosion and cursing enemies within range. The [b]Curse debuff[/b] makes enemies take damage the next time they attack. When combined with Pink Magic Cards the cards gain [b]Energy Flux[/b] which provides a damage boost to the skill for each skill Ace has on cooldown. notes.title: Dandy Ace's "Twitch Mode"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/c245d420a1e5cf9acc022e7a74f2d32cd8dfd231.png[/img]

The Dandy Ace team has been having a blast watching all of the streamers playing in Twitch Mode during our [b]Dandy Ace Creators’ Preview Event[/b] so far. Everyone can download the latest free demo from the Dandy Ace Steam Page and participate in the event. Players can also hop into Twitch streams and participate in Twitch Mode as a viewer throughout the event period!

[b]Twitch Mode[/b] is always unlocked right from the start for any Twitch streamers to take advantage of across any difficulty settings they have unlocked. While playing in Twitch Mode players will continue to be able to unlock all of the same content available in the Standard Mode and will be able to switch between the two modes while maintaining their progress in the run. The mode can be customized to the streamers liking, turning on only the specific voting features they want. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/37cNZ49/Twitch-Mode-Giff.gif[/img]

Twitch Mode allows viewers to be able to interact directly with the streamer through chat. Viewers can decide how they want to impact the streamer’s run whether it be to help them progress or make things more challenging overall. Votes are held to determine which level the streamer will head to next, which cards will drop during the run, and one lucky viewer will also have the opportunity to become Dandy Ace’s antagonist, Lele the Green-Eyed Illusionist! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/129bcee6356368a76ce46cd5fd7501c0de4b95e6.png[/img]

Twitch Mode features several different options that can be turned on or off by the streamer, including:

[h3][u]Lele Mode[/u][/h3]
When activated, “Lele Mode” allows one viewer to become Lele for a short period of time. Viewers apply for the role by typing “Lele” into chat when prompted to do so. Lele is then randomly selected from those that have applied and is able to interact with the streamer via chat commands. 

As Lele, the viewer gains access to a handful of his Magic Tricks and Cards for a period of time to try to stop Ace from progressing such as:
[u][b]Cards/Skills[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Time Dissonance
[*] Black Hole
[*] Call Lightning
[*] Escape Artist
[*] Packet Trick
[/list]

[u][b]Magic Tricks[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Block Random Card[/b]
[list][*] Blocks a card from being used for a short period of time[/list]
[*] [b]Block Tea Potion[/b]
[list][*] Prevents Ace from using Tea Potions to heal for a period of time[/list]
[*] T[b]witch Cupcake[/b]
[list][*] A cupcake that can either heal or damage Ace, but it will never kill Ace fully.[/list]
[*][b] Spawn Random Enemies[/b]
[list][*] Several enemies will spawn around Ace with the viewer’s name above them[/list]
[/list]

[u][h3]Level Selection Poll[/h3][/u]
The Level Selection Poll gives viewers control over the streamer’s path through the Cursed Mirror and Lele’s Palace. Viewers in the chat are able to vote on the next level the streamer will have to enter and get through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/d438f6f25e2d4a2428c9bd4323f0a66cdc4948ea.png[/img]

[u][h3]Twitch Cards[/h3][/u]
With this feature enabled viewers in the chat will be able to vote for the card you will receive from Arenas, Treasure Chests, and one card at the Shopkeepers. This replaces the cards you would normally receive from these drops.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/fGTw0mR/Twitch-Card-Gif.gif[/img][/url]


[h3][u]Twitch Reward Tent[/u][/h3]
The Twitch Reward Tent replaces the Reward Tents found in Standard Mode at the beginning of each level. When the Twitch Reward Tent is enabled, viewers in the chat are able to vote on what additional prize you will earn along with replenishing your Tea Potions.

[h3][u]Twitch Reaction[/u][/h3]
When Twitch Reaction is enabled, users are able to send short messages to the streamer that will appear on screen. This feature will only appear after defeating a boss or after dying. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/dabe4ba9bf0d885cad97df36b3d9991e4a3d40bf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/78c042d1680517a0fb3a2a9c5f9fd9a0bfe9ac71.png[/img][/url]

[h3]**Update**[/h3]

[b]More customization options!: [/b]We added an Advanced Settings screen that will allow streamers to customize the duration of Twitch Mode interactions. Adjust how often each vote feature appears and for how long.

notes.title: Welcome to the Garden: Lady Thorn & the Oozes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cUgBPT9_5qg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][b]Garden[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/1fb2d8568b3578e7f2b80ace3f558c7cfc4dc1ae.png[/img]
Located just beyond the [b]Courtyard[/b] outside of the Palace, the [b]Garden[/b] leads to Dandy Ace’s 2nd boss otherwise known as [b]Scissorella, The Royal Gardener[/b]! Scissorella's own Garden is an extension of this map full of untidy bushes and a darker/more mischievous tone overall. The Garden features a wide variety of plants, statues, and enemies. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4fyB6Lq/Scissorella-Intro.gif[/img]

Dandy Ace will not only need to fight off [b]Lady Thorns[/b], [b]Oozes[/b], [b]Poison Turrets[/b] and [b]Explosive Totems[/b] but also be careful where he fires off his skills as the Garden is home to a plant based environmental hazard that activates when it takes damage! After a short delay the[b] Plant Bomb[/b] will burst open dealing damage to anything near it. Ace can kite or knock enemies into the [b]Plant Bomb’s[/b] radius to deal significant damage to them when the plants burst. After a short period of time the plants will grow back and can be activated again.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hsbt2r7/Garden-Gif2.gif[/img]

[h1]Lady Thorns[/h1]
[code]                          [img]https://i.ibb.co/V39Z45s/Minirela-Idlesm.gif[/img]
          [/code]

Prior to the fight against Scissorella Ace will have to get past a legion of Oozes as well as [b]Lady Thorn[/b]s, also known as Minirella![b] Lady Thorns[/b] is a humanoid enemy and one of Lele’s Palace Guests that shares visual similarities with Scissorella. Both of the skills Lady Thorns utilizes will be similar to those Ace will encounter in the boss fight but on a smaller scale. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/nrb68wk/Garden-Gif3.gif[/img]

Lady Thorns has two offensive skills and no defensive skills. Once spotted, Lady Thorns will chase after Ace attempting to perform[b] Smash Rebound[/b] when in melee range. On activation Lady Thorns will swipe at Ace dealing damage and leaving behind an AOE that explodes after a short delay. At range she has [b]Thorn Barrage[/b] at her disposal. When used Lady Thorns will fire a barrage of thorns that sweep across an area in Ace’s general direction dealing damage to anything caught within it.

[h1]Oozes[/h1]
[code]                       [img]https://i.ibb.co/6DzY2z7/Ooze-Idle.gif[/img]
          [/code]

Under the control of Scissorella, the [b]Big Oozes[/b], [b]Ooze Dudes[/b], and [b]Mini-Oozes[/b] help Lady Thorns keep watch over the Garden and Courtyard. With the ability to split itself into smaller Oozes things can quickly get overwhelming if Ace isn't equipped to deal with large groups of enemies. On death, Oozes will split into multiple smaller versions of themselves with more limited skill sets the smaller the Ooze gets. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/m8mJ8yZ/OozeGif1.gif[/img]

[b]Big Oozes[/b] & [b]Ooze Dude[/b]s are able to leave behind an [b]Ooze Trail[/b] wherever they travel. If Ace attempts to walk over the trail he will take damage. When within range of Ace, the Ooze will attempt to [b]Charge[/b] in Ace's direction dealing damage if it hits. Big Oozes will follow up the [b]Charge[/b] with an [b]Ooze Burst[/b] covering the area around it with ooze for a short period of time. Standing within range of the burst or in the remaining ooze will cause Ace to take damage. The defensive skill only available to Big Oozes is [b]Multiply[/b], allowing it to spawn two Oozes alongside it. [b]Mini-Oozes[/b] will continue to chase after Ace but are much less of a threat due to their lack of offensive and defensive skills.

[h1]Explosive Totems & Poison Turrets[/h1]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/9qynHZN/Explosive-Totem-Poison-Turret-Gif.gif[/img]

[b]Poison Turrets[/b] will have Ace constantly moving to avoid the giant poison clouds while fighting off enemies. The combination of Oozes and Poison Turrets can make it difficult to find space to fight in tighter parts of the map. [b]Explosive Totems[/b] combo well with Oozes, adding onto their ability to multiply and split. The Explosive Totem applies [b]Explosive Buff[/b] to enemies within its range. Any enemy with the buff active will explode on death after a brief delay dealing damage to Ace if he remains too close. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/nCJ9ZVb/Poison-Turret-Gif.gif[/img]

Venture into the Garden when Dandy Ace releases on Steam, Xbox, Playstation, and Switch in early 2021! Thank you to everyone that participated in our Second Beta Test. The Mad Mimic team appreciates all of the feedback we’ve received and we look forward to seeing how you all react to the new changes and additions to the game in our next beta early next year. notes.title: Meet The Voices: Voice Actor Derek Trowell
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/e5b44cc20eb48e89976063ffbc6395db92dd13f6.png[/img]

There are lots of interesting personalities to meet in Dandy Ace. The Mad Mimic team has had the opportunity to work with a few amazing voice actors that have brought them all to life. From the various bosses and minions to our lead protagonist Ace and his twin stage assistants, Jolly Jolly & Jenny Jenny, the actors provide a voice to the characters you’ll run into while making your way through the Cursed Mirror and Lele’s ever-changing Palace!

[previewyoutube=0TdpA0xqkDw;full][/previewyoutube]

Get some insights into the voice acting process and meet the voice behind Dandy Ace, Lele The Green-Eyed Illusionis, Axolangelo The Artist, and many more in our interview with voice actor [b]Derek Trowell[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/52c3a4a9ab36cadfe3a524fefbc11cdd7af0a826.png[/img]

[b]What is your name and a brief introduction to yourself?[/b]

Hi, my name is Derek Trowell and I voiced Dandy Ace, Lele The Green-Eyed Illusionist, Axolangelo The Artist, Severino The Gatekeeper, and Nnif The Smuggler.

[b]What was the process like to create a voice for the character(s) in Dandy Ace?[/b]

Working with Luis and Mad Mimic is a treat because I know they are going to put out a great product. Luis and the design team know what they want and give great direction to craft the characters and their voices. There was a lot of back and forth to get the voices just right and I really think it shows.

[b]What were the major aspects of the character(s) you were trying to portray through their voice?[/b]

Well Lele and Axolangelo show a wide range of emotion.  Lele's personality is complex. He is so jealous of Ace, but also in awe of him. I actually had a tougher time creating Dandy Ace himself. Personally, I find it easier to be a villain. Being likable is more difficult for me, lol.

[b]Are there any particular lines of dialogue that were your favorite to perform?[/b]

Actually I really enjoy doing Lele's laugh. Voicing Lele takes a lot of energy but is a lot of fun! I would often crack up in front of the mic doing some of his lines.
 [previewyoutube=wN9RYIUk5ug;full][/previewyoutube]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/004a898813b88d182d52e2e96e32fbd674e49fca.png[/img]
       [/code]
[i]The main antagonist of Dandy Ace. Lele is an ugly tyrant that both admires and hates Ace. His
obsession grows so much that he sells his own soul to trap Ace inside The Cursed Mirror.[/i]
 
[b]Do you have a favorite character in Dandy Ace?[/b]

There are lots of really cool enemies - like the Cuckoo Nightmare and Scissorella.  I really dig the look of Axolangelo stylistically and his personality is really open with his ever-changing emotions.  I also really like Nnif the smuggler- how he is a self-made bunny in an ever-changing world.  I hope he gets out.
[previewyoutube=f-HkepBYNKc;full][/previewyoutube]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/0d4251c3628d063ccfe6e590c698eddbdd08f8db.png[/img]
       [/code]
[i]Nnif is one the bunnies under Lele's command that decided to end his services and started a rogue life as a smuggler providing a wide range of upgrades in exchange for shards.[/i]

[b]Do you have any advice for people interested in getting into voice acting?[/b]

I would say go to where the voices are needed.  There are lots of animation or sound design students who need fresh voices and that is a good way to build a good portfolio of work to show others. There are also online platforms that post lots of jobs that need voice actors for a variety of projects.

[b]Thanks for taking the time to answer these questions! Where can people follow you or check out some of your other work?[/b]

I have a Facebook page for the odd post or you can check out my demo reel video on Youtube!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Derek-Trowell-1635558593392049/

notes.title: Enemy Spotlight: Turrets & Totems
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=SgZZiBp4Jcs;full][/previewyoutube]
This week we’ll be taking a look at the stationary enemies of Dandy Ace, [b]Turrets[/b] and [b]Totems[/b]. While these enemies may not be able to move or avoid Ace’s attacks, they provide ranged support and buffs to other enemies. Ace will run into a variety of different types of [b]Turrets[/b] and [b]Totems[/b] in each map as he makes his way through the Cursed Mirror to Lele’s Palace. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/44d36309a21d33b667b60c26ab055bf431b6ee3e.png[/img]

[b][h2]TURRETS[/h2][/b]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/1a9927c08ffb47f7753fab0bf873c98d8489ba3d.gif[/img] 
       [/code]
[b]Turrets[/b] are stationary enemies with offensive ranged attacks and no defensive capabilities. Ace will need to constantly watch his back for flying turret projectiles as he faces off against other enemies. They’ve got a long range and can be positioned in different ways around the maps. Turrets are most often placed on their own platforms outside of the regular playspace but can also appear alongside groups of enemies within it. While Ace should be able to reach most turrets with melee and close-ranged skills, longer ranged skills are recommended. 

Between attacks, turrets are vulnerable and have no way to defend themselves which opens up a window for Ace to take them out. [b]Turrets[/b] come in four different types: [b]Basic Turret[/b],[b] Homing Turret[/b],[b] Multi-Shot Turret[/b], and [b]Poison Turret[/b]. The easiest way to determine which type of turret you are facing during an encounter is to look at the type of projectile located above the turret base.

[h2]Basic Turret[/h2]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/sR9k4vW/basicturretgif.gif[/img][/url]
The[b] Basic Turret[/b] is the first type of stationary enemy Ace will encounter right away as he enters the [b]Entrance Hall[/b]. It was designed to introduce the [b]Turret[/b] enemy type to players without being too overwhelming or complicated. It can be distinguished by its [b]Flaming Projectiles[/b]. When Ace is within range, the[b] Basic Turret [/b]will fire a[b] Flaming Projectile[/b] in Ace’s direction every few seconds. The projectile will continue to travel over obstacles and through enemies in a straight line until it reaches its max range or hits Ace. If the projectile hits, Ace will take a significant amount of damage.

[h2]Homing Turret[/h2]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/KGKyHPQ/homingif.gif[/img][/url]
The next turret type is the [b]Homing Turret[/b] which can be found in the [b]Guest Lounge[/b]. While the base of the [b]Homing Turret[/b] is the same, the projectile itself is different from that of the [b]Basic Turret[/b] and can be seen pictured above. The [b]Homing Turret[/b] fires a [b]Homing Projectile[/b] that will attempt to chase after Ace for a short period of time. If it collides with Ace, the player will take a significant amount of damage. 


[h2]Multi-Shot Turret[/h2]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/cQb9GDJ/multiturretgif.gif[/img][/url]
Found in the [b]Palace Shop[/b] and [b]Central Hall[/b], three projectiles can be seen floating above [b]Multi-Shot Turrets[/b]. The [b]Multi-Shot Turret[/b] will make Ace question how close he should attempt to get when fighting it. Acting as the shotgun of turrets, the [b]Multi-Shot Turret[/b] fires [b]Spread Shot[/b] towards Ace when within range. [b]Spread Shot[/b] sends out 3 projectiles at the same time in a cone, each dealing its own damage on successful hit. The effectiveness of this turret drops off the further Ace is as it becomes more difficult for multiple projectiles to hit.


[h2]Poison Turret[/h2]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/LxYyv8g/poisongif.gif[/img][/url]
The final turret type found within Dandy Ace is the [b]Poison Turret[/b]. First encountered in the [b]Garden[/b], the[b] Poison Turret[/b] is great for denying large areas and forcing Ace to maneuver around smaller pathways more carefully. [b]Poison Turrets[/b] utilize their [b]Poison Cloud[/b] attack every few seconds to send out a large projectile in Ace’s direction. The projectile travels slowly in a straight line before disappearing once it reaches its max range. [b]Poison Cloud [/b]will deal AoE damage over time to Ace for as long as he remains within the cloud’s radius. [b]Poison Turrets[/b] can also be found in [b]Courtyard[/b].


[b][h2]TOTEMS[/h2][/b]

[b]Totems[/b] do not have any offensive capabilities and their defensive options are very limited. These stationary enemies focus on buffing their allies to make them more powerful. In most cases Ace will want, or even need to, take out the[b] Totems[/b] first during a combat encounter as the buffs they provide to other enemies are significant. They are extremely vulnerable with no way to fight back against Ace and rely on their allies to defend them.

The [b]Totem[/b] will often spawn in the middle of enemy groups, towards the center of stages. This provides them some level of protection while buffing as many enemies as possible at the same time. The[b] Totem[/b] enemy type has its skill active at all times while it is still alive and its massive AoE range is clearly displayed to players to know when enemies are receiving a totem’s buff. Just like with Turrets, there are four [b]Totems[/b] types: [b]Protective Totem, Explosive Totem, Health Totem,[/b] and [b]Power Totem[/b]. 

[h2]Protective Totem[/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/05d83f59278b0f60d2c1c945e40ae667ef55f26a.gif[/img] 
       [/code]
One of the [b]Totem[/b] types Ace will encounter is the [b]Protective Totem[/b], found in the[b] Central Hall[/b]. [b]Protective Totems[/b] are blue in color and provide a [b]Defensive Buff[/b] to any enemies within range. When under the effects of [b]Defensive Buff[/b], enemies will take significantly less damage from Ace’s skills. Enemies will feel almost immune to Ace’s skills so taking out the [b]Protective Totem[/b] as quickly as possible will be important.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/6N8LYQF/protgif.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Explosive Totem[/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/42619b6dde92d14db550c8483ae39edd30cef165.gif[/img] 
       [/code]
The next totem type will have Ace keeping his distance from enemies and being a lot more careful if utilizing AoE skills. The [b]Explosive Totem[/b] applies [b]Explosive Buff[/b] to enemies within its range. Any enemy with the [b]Explosive Buff [/b]active will explode on death dealing damage to Ace if he remains too close. [b]The Explosive Totem[/b] appears in the [b]Courtyard[/b] but can also be found in the [b]Garden[/b].

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/9VtNDYC/ezgif-5-424f51998cc3.gif[/img][/url]

[b][h2]Healing Totem[/h2][/b]
[code]        [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/65e2d41803491b0c4a4d815b3de0681f7737cb43.png[/img]
       [/code]
The one totem with some defensive capability is the [b]Healing Totem[/b], designed in the shape of a layer cake. Any enemies, including the [b]Healing Totem[/b] itself, will have [b]Health Rege[/b]n when within the totem’s radius. Under the effects of [b]Health Regen[/b], the enemy will constantly heal over time very quickly. This can make taking down the Healing Totem really difficult in one go. Players will encounter the [b]Healing Totem[/b] in the [b]Art Gallery[/b].

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/L1LX096/healingtotemgif.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Power Totem[/h2]
[code]                       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34727433/bdc03965a8ec26a5a550733cc0daf2fd6b77d596.gif[/img]
       [/code]
The final totem type is the[b] Power Totem[/b]. Pink and purple in color, this totem’s buff is fairly straightforward and can be found within the [b]Palace Shop[/b] and [b]Gala Hall[/b] maps. If within range of the [b]Power Totem[/b], enemies will gain [b]Power Buff[/b] increasing all of the damage they deal. Ace’s health will quickly go from full to 0 in a matter of seconds if he isn’t careful around the buffed enemies and especially against larger groups in smaller spaces.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/DDwdkt3/powergif.gif[/img][/url]

Tune in next week as we meet with the voices behind some of the characters of Dandy Ace and learn about the process of having unique voices created for each character. Be sure to add Dandy Ace to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037130/Dandy_Ace/][b]Steam Wishlist[/b][/url] and follow us on all social media to stay up to date as we post new announcements such as upcoming betas and events leading up to the launch in early 2021! You can also join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/EDby5gp]Mad Mimic Community Discord[/url] to chat with members of the development team as well as other community members.
